summary:
Iteration 62 retest (copy cleanup verification): All 9 backend test files executed together → 156/156 PASSED in 4.19s. JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter62_all.xml. All 3 minor copy issues flagged in iteration_61 are now fixed and verified via source introspection + functional runtime checks:

1) _discovery_addendum (lines 132-195) — REWRITTEN as free-form smart discovery. Contains 'بحرية' (2×) and 'مخصّصة' (1×). Legacy '8 أسئلة كلها' and '/8' strings COMPLETELY REMOVED (grep counts = 0). New copy explicitly tells the AI to ask smart questions tailored to the customer's idea ('اطرح أسئلة ذكية مخصّصة لفكرة العميل'), lists 4 required topics + 4 optional topics with descriptions, and uses the gate phrase 'الحد الأدنى المطلوب قبل البناء: 4 مواضيع أساسية'.

2) can_advance_to (line 307) — block message now reads exactly 'Discovery غير مكتمل (3/4 موضوع أساسي). أكمل المواضيع الأساسية الناقصة أولاً.' Uses DISCOVERY_REQUIRED_TOPICS to count answered topics (not DISCOVERY_QUESTIONS). Verified at runtime: 3 of 4 → returns (False, '…3/4 موضوع أساسي…').

3) Functional re-confirmation: discovery_complete returns False with 3/4 required topics, True with 4/4 (regardless of optional); stage_prompt_addendum on empty discovery state contains 'بحرية'.

Regression: ALL 9 test files pass with no broken assertions. Per-file counts unchanged from iter-61: test_ai_mode 27, test_ai_mode_three_modes 17, test_admin_ai_mode_http 8, test_surgical_fixes 26, test_surgical_fixes_v2 24, test_openai_param_compat 12, test_intent_scope_fix 5, test_pre_finish_gate 6, test_workflow_engine 31 = 156 total. The two updated tests in test_workflow_engine.py (test_discovery_addendum_lists_remaining_questions, test_discovery_addendum_omits_already_answered) both PASS with the new wording assertions.

source_introspection_results.can_advance_block_message_text: Discovery غير مكتمل (3/4 موضوع أساسي). أكمل المواضيع الأساسية الناقصة أولاً.

critical_code_review_comments: Cleanup is fully delivered. DISCOVERY_QUESTIONS (8 items) is still kept but now used only as advisory hints inside the addendum's framework — no longer drives advancement counts. The legacy stub _surgical_edit_addendum_OLD_REMOVED (line 285-289) is still dead code from iter-61 — can be deleted in a future refactor (non-blocking).

Prior maintainability comment still stands: freebuild_agent.py is ~10,600 lines, well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend extracting TOOLS_SCHEMA / _exec_tool dispatcher / provider stream loops in a dedicated refactor pass — not blocking for this iteration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-62 closes out the 3 minor copy issues from iter-61. workflow_engine.py is now spec-aligned: free-form discovery addendum with بحرية + مخصّصة wording referencing 4 required + 4 optional topics; can_advance_to block message reports X/4 موضوع أساسي. All 156 tests still pass; no regressions detected. Live VPS verification (per request context) already confirms the new strings are deployed. Safe to consider iteration 8 fully complete.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification-only iteration. The 3 minor copy items from iter-61 (legacy '8 questions' framing, missing بحرية/مخصّصة wording, '/8' denominator in block message) are all corrected at the source as required, and the test suite remains green at 156/156.
